goal: Decide the next safe FA balancing-account route after FIXEDASSETS-164 showed Acquisition Cost Bal. Acc. on MACHINES but no concrete value.

targetQuestion.decisionNeeded: Is the blank acquisition-cost balancing account intentional for the manual FA G/L Journal route, or should a separate UI-first setup-fit case populate/prove it before value entry?

safetyGates: No Business Central live action is required for the decision.
Do not enter Amount or Bal. Account No. in FA G/L Journals.
Do not use account codes 12210/82000 as balancing accounts unless the exact field/value source is proven or a new setup-fit case explicitly sets the value.
Do not open Preview Posting or Post.
If setup fit is selected, create a separate case with before/after evidence, account rationale and rollback/trace plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision states whether FA G/L Journal value entry remains blocked.
Decision states whether a setup-fit case is needed.
Decision names the exact field and page that would be changed if a setup-fit is later allowed.
Decision does not claim German final proof.
State points to one concrete next safe case.
nextSafeAction: Run FIXEDASSETS-166 read-only account-candidate discovery before any setup-fit or FA G/L Journal value-entry case.

lastResult.summary: No arbitrary balancing account. Read-only G/L account candidate discovery is required before any setup-fit or journal value-entry case.
